reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
ABH IL will only reimburse for the appropriate reporting of Holter monitoring when 
 
Services are reported with an ICD-10-CM diagnosis code that indicates a cardiac 
symptom or event as listed in this policy. 
 
Claims that are submitted will be denied when 
 
services are reported without an ICD-10-CM diagnosis code that does not indicate a 
cardiac symptom or event. 
 
The medical record documentation is expected to support the specific CPT code(s) and ICD-10-
CM codes reported.

The state administered program that provides health coverage to

disabilities, according to federal requirements. The program is
funded jointly by states and the federal government.

Medicare is a health insurance program for: people aged sixty-
five (65) or older, people under age sixty-five (65) with certain
disabilities, and people of all ages with End-Stage Renal Disease
(permanent kidney failure requiring dialysis or a kidney
transplant).

CPT Codes
93224 External electrocardiographic recording up to 48 hours by continuous
rhythm recording and storage; includes recording, scanning analysis with
report, review and interpretation by a physician or other qualified health
care professional

rhythm recording and storage; recording (includes connection, recording,
and disconnection)
93226 External electrocardiographic recording up to 48 hours by continuous
rhythm recording and storage; scanning analysis with report
93227 External electrocardiographic recording up to 48 hours by continuous
rhythm recording and storage; review and interpretation by a physician or
other qualified health care professional
Supported ICD-10-CM Codes
